thinking_text:
**Formulating design considerations**

I’m considering the changes needed for a design, especially about handle placement and how the bottom may change. I should probably look into whether the side wall body needs an attachment while keeping the overall device body intact. I’m also thinking about how to describe these operations, perhaps with “interface” as the final state. It sounds like I might need to use functions in a compact way to clarify my ideas.

request.raw_text: Imagine the black handle is a stand. Add another one on the other side of device in approximately same distane from side wall as the existing one. Remove the Cordholder. Cut the bottom of the handles so it allows the device to be stable on a flat surface.
action_words: use the black handle as a stand
cut the bottom of the handles
parameter_words: approximately same distance from side wall as the existing one
functional_intention_words: allows the device to be stable on a flat surface

aim.primary_aim: Provide the device with two opposing handle-derived stands that support it stably on a flat surface, while eliminating the Cordholder and otherwise preserving the device.

functional_design_intentions.name: Handle-derived support
functional_design_intentions.description: The existing black handle and one added counterpart are intended to function as stands for the device.

functional_design_intentions.name: Flat-surface stability
functional_design_intentions.description: The lower portions of both handles should permit the device to rest stably on a flat surface.

functional_design_intentions.name: Opposing support placement
functional_design_intentions.description: The added stand should be located on the other side of the device at approximately the same side-wall offset as the existing handle.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: A second handle-derived stand on the other side of the device

parameters.name: side-wall offset
parameters.value: approximately the same as the existing black handle

required_relationships.reference: the other side of the device relative to the existing black handle
distance between the existing black handle and its corresponding side wall

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: The bottom portions of the existing black handle and the added handle-derived stand

parameters.name: support surface compatibility
parameters.value: stable resting on a flat surface

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Existing black handle except for its bottom portion
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the existing handle's overall identity and placement while changing only its bottom geometry as required for stable support.

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Device geometry not targeted by the stand addition, handle-bottom modification, or Cordholder removal
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve all non-targeted geometry under a minimum-change rule.

geometry.description: One additional handle-derived stand exists on the other side of the device at approximately the same distance from its corresponding side wall as the existing black handle.

properties.name: side-wall offset
properties.value: approximately equal to the existing handle offset

geometry.description: The Cordholder is absent from the final device.
The bottoms of both handle-derived stands have geometry that permits stable support of the device on a flat surface.

functions.name: Support device
functions.description: The existing and added handle-derived stands support the device on a flat surface.

functions.name: Provide two-sided stand support
functions.description: The two stands provide support from opposing sides of the device.

behaviors.name: Stable resting
behaviors.description: When placed on a flat surface, the device rests without instability attributable to the bottoms of the handles.

validation_criteria.description: Exactly one additional handle-derived stand is present.
The additional stand is on the other side of the device and is approximately the same distance from its corresponding side wall as the existing black handle.
The bottom geometry of both handle-derived stands is compatible with resting on a flat surface.
Both handle-derived stands support the device when it is placed on a flat surface.
The device rests stably on a flat surface using the modified handle bottoms.
Non-targeted device geometry remains unchanged except where necessarily associated with the requested stand addition, handle-bottom changes, and Cordholder removal.

unresolved_requirements.description: The existing black handle, Cordholder, and applicable side walls are named semantically but have no exact model identifiers.
candidate_interpretations: Identify the targets from their model names or semantic labels.
Identify the black handle from its visual appearance and the Cordholder from its form or placement.

unresolved_requirements.description: The phrase 'other side of device' does not specify a named side or orientation.
candidate_interpretations: The opposite lateral side from the existing black handle.
The side wall opposing the side wall nearest the existing black handle.

unresolved_requirements.description: No numerical tolerance is supplied for the approximately equal side-wall distance.
candidate_interpretations: Match the existing handle-to-side-wall offset as closely as practical.
Allow a small non-numerical placement difference while maintaining visibly comparable offsets.

unresolved_requirements.description: The exact bottom geometry needed to produce stability on a flat surface is not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Both handle bottoms provide compatible flat support regions.
The handle bottoms and any existing lower device contacts collectively define a stable support condition.
